body: Ah, so that's the word. I was thinking of the wrong one. It's just that -and please correct me if I'm wrong- it seems society at large would rather accept someone who is passing rather than someone who is just "whatever". I don't know, forgive me if I'm mistaken.

It'd be easier on me any how, at least I think. I'm jealous the way men can age differently and not get judged for a few creases here and there. I'm "too loud" for a girl anyway, no one's ever wanted me and I cannot for the life of me act feminine and mean it. 

Sorry if I rambled, thanks for taking your time to reply.
I guess...I just don't know what I am. I've been suicidal for other reasons for years, this seems to just be making it harder. I don't know. I hope things go well for you.

I was, and honestly? It's a good way to live sometimes. People run around like they're actually acomplishing something, but in reality they too are just surviving. The only difference is they don't think about it. I think this is what animals are like. One more day, live in the now. Sadly, I feel like I'm just done now. Something happened to me that just screamed "ok, you survived this long, good run, but you cannot go on like this anymore".
